key_features: Stable & Durable：Built with premium carbon steel and a stainless coating,the PUTORSEN Projector Stand offers exceptional durability. The solid all-metal square base ensures stability and can support a loading capacity of up to 11 lbs

360° Rotation:The projector stand comes with a high-quality ball head that allows for a 360° horizontal rotation and 90° tilt.This provides the flexibility to project from any angle. Easily adjust your setup to achieve the perfect viewing experience

Height Adjustable:The Projector Stand can quickly and easily adjust the height from 36.6" to 48.75" depending on your needs.The height-adjustable clamp-style knobs securely lock the stand into position

Sleek & Minimalist Design:With a sleek, minimalist "L" shape design, this projector stand seamlessly blends into any living room, bedroom, or office decor. Its space-saving structure allows for easy placement behind sofas, beds, or other furniture, making it both stylish and functional

Compatibility Notice and Reliable Support:Please note that the Projector Stand is exclusively compatible with projectors featuring a 1/4" bottom center screw hole. We kindly advise verifying your projector's specifications before making a purchase. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact us for assistance
